summary: dellemc.openmanage 11.7.0 adds iDRAC10 support to idrac_attributes (module and role), idrac_lifecycle_controller_jobs, idrac_lifecycle_controller_status_info, idrac_user_info and idrac_virtual_media, and deprecates idrac_syslog.

answer_card.title: openmanage changes in 11.7.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- iDRAC10 support: `idrac_attributes` (module and role), `idrac_lifecycle_controller_jobs`, `idrac_lifecycle_controller_status_info`, `idrac_user_info`, `idrac_virtual_media`.
- `idrac_syslog` is deprecated.
